bull.b: Elfabrio is showing tangible commercial traction, supported by higher partner sales and expanded geographic and dosing approvals. Broader access can improve adoption and market penetration, giving Protalix a recurring product foundation beyond individual development milestones.

The turnaround to positive earnings and strong reported margins indicates that the commercial business can generate meaningful operating leverage. If product sales remain durable, this profitability creates internal funding capacity for pipeline investment and improves financial resilience.

A cash-rich, debt-free balance sheet gives Protalix flexibility to sustain operations, advance clinical programs, and manage uneven biotechnology cash flows. Limited financing obligations also reduce near-term pressure on capital allocation and preserve strategic partnering options.

bear.b: Dependence on Chiesi purchasing patterns makes reported revenue timing less predictable and increases concentration risk. Uneven shipments can obscure underlying demand, complicate forecasting, and create periods in which earnings and cash generation diverge from product progress.

The milestone materially boosted near-term revenue and makes year-over-year performance less representative of recurring product economics. Without similar payments, reported growth and profitability may moderate, placing greater importance on sustained Elfabrio sales.

A high observed antibody rate introduces a substantive development risk for PRX-115, since immunogenicity and infusion reactions may constrain dosing or require regimen changes. This could delay advancement, increase development complexity, or reduce the program’s commercial potential.
